comments.label: Episode E-002Choose another episodeRussia's Kosmos 2542 and Kosmo
comments.text:
Remember, these index numbers ("E-002") are for developer use only; they won't be in the final version, so they shouldn't be here either.

In general, I'm not feeling so satisfied with this episode name area. I think it's maybe drawing too _much_ attention? I'm not sure. I think I would like to see you get creative and come up with a few more ideas for how to show what I want to show:
1. What episode we're currently on; and
2. That there are other episodes to go look at, if you want to.

One way to achieve the latter is by having buttons to go to the next or previous episode, in addition to or instead of going back to the episode library. I'd like you to try a few ideas for how to do this and let me investigate them.

comments.label: Kosmos 2543 Orbital Details
comments.text: You can delete the word "Selected"; should just say "TLE epoch".

comments.label: Separation metric
comments.text: Maybe you can add a subtle horizontal line here to separate inputs from results.

comments.label: Separation distance over time; drag the horizontal threshold line to adjust
comments.text: I do want to see what this looks like with real data, so I can offer comments on that. On the next round, please actually pull data to fill this chart. Remember, it's a function of the satellite toggle position. If the toggle is on Kosmos 2542, then the separation distance should show the distance between Kosmos 2542 and USA-245. But if the toggle is on Kosmos 2543, then this chart should show the separation distance between Kosmos 2543 and USA 245.
